dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The Great Volcano of Tollan... I have heard this is the manner in which the people of today refer to the Sacred City.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Is that where the Mirror of the Dawning Morn yearned to go? The place she hoped she might belong?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...No one is waiting for her return. Not even there.
